free_tier_limits: No published numeric quota. Free basic access is subject to fair use: throttle requests, avoid duplicate or excessive queries, and self-host or import the data for high-volume use. Administrators may block abusive callers.
description: Open Charge Map provides a free API for querying its global registry of electric-vehicle charging locations. Developers can search by location, filter by connector type and operator/network, and retrieve detailed site, equipment, access, and status data. A free API key is required. No numerical quota is published; qualitative fair-use rules apply, and excessive or indiscriminate callers may be blocked.
resolution_notes: docs_url: corrected; the old /site/develop/api route now redirects to sign-in, while the official documentation is https://www.openchargemap.org/develop/api. free_tier_limits: corrected; that page publishes qualitative fair-use rules and discretionary blocking, not a numeric quota. description: corrected to remove the unsupported claim of documented rate limits; evidence: https://www.openchargemap.org/develop/api.
